name: shrike-security
description: Governs the actions Claude Code takes, against the policy you declare. Scans commands, file writes, notebook edits, web searches and fetches, and the brief handed to a sub-agent before they execute, applying your policy in real time to what's allowed, warned, held for approval, or blocked. Shrike doesn't decide on its own authority; you declare the policy and Shrike enforces it. Scans the reply and a sub-agent's report, keys every scan to the exchange it served, records what Claude Code's own permission layer decided beside Shrike's verdict, and bundles the governed-tool-use skill plus the shrike-mcp security tools.

api_key.title: Shrike API key
api_key.description: Enables enforcement. Without a key the hook installs but governs nothing. Free key at https://shrikesecurity.com

scan_conversation.title: Scan prompts and replies
scan_conversation.description: Off by default. When on, your prompts and Claude's final reply each turn are sent to Shrike and checked on the observe plane. These checks never block anything; a flagged prompt or reply is only noted.
